title: Kill Switch Lanyard for Yamaha – Safety Cord
descriptionHtml:
A small detail that can save lives

If the driver falls overboard, the engine should shut off immediately. A worn or missing kill switch lanyard is a risk you don't want to take on the water.

A spare that should always be on board

This kill switch lanyard with wrist strap fits Yamaha outboard motors and replaces EW2-68348-00-00. Always keep an extra on board, just to be safe.

Features

  • Shuts off the engine if the driver falls overboard
  • With a handy wrist strap
  • Fits Yamaha outboard motors
  • Replaces EW2-68348-00-00
  • Good to have as a spare on board

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
